getting_there.text: Church parking Monday–Friday 06:00–08:00/17:00–19:00, Saturday 06:00–19:30, Sunday 06:00–13:00/17:00–19:30. Bus 50/70/70A/70B/70M/103/104/854; website names Buangkok/Thanggam as nearest rail stops but warns they are not nearby.

Jalan Resak carpark gate closes immediately after Mass; exit via Yio Chu Kang Road autogate. Do not block priests’ lots or park along 1–19 Jalan Jarak. Parish-published alternative arrangements: Yio Chu Kang Road lampposts 156–166 and Jalan Kelulut 4–9 only Saturday 18:00–19:15/Sunday 09:00–12:15; paid Jalan Kelulut shophouse parking or HDB Block 988 Buangkok Green.

sacraments.text: Suspended from 1 May 2026 until further notice: no new registrations/intakes. Parish focusing on sponsor/volunteer formation; seekers directed to other parishes. Older Thursday 2025/26 schedule below notice is not a current intake.

Infant/child eligibility below 7 with at least one practising Catholic parent and parents’ marriage solemnised/convalidated in church; speak to parish priest for other family situations.2026 schedule, guidelines, registration and minor-consent PDFs linked.
Bring birth and baptism certificates; attend Catholic Engaged Encounter weekend or Marriage Preparation Course (six half-day weekend sessions). Parish-specific lead time not stated in captured FAQ.
Request Anointing link on sacrament page. For pastoral enquiries contact Pastoral Executive 6481 0036, pastoral.csvdp@catholic.org.sg.
L1 registration begins 1 October 2026 using mycatholic.sg portal. QR tutorial in bulletin; contact Catechetical Coordinator for other enquiries.
Next listed baptism 22 November 2026 at 12:30 in Main Church; preparation 15 November 14:00–16:00 Room 03-04.

Online application at least 2 weeks before baptism, with child birth certificate, parents marriage certificates, godparents baptism/confirmation certificates. At least one practising Catholic parent. Both parents/godparents attend in-person preparation, usually one week before; child need not attend. Office verifies documents, may sight originals or request priest consultation, then confirms schedule. Guidelines dated 1 February 2025.

ministries.text: Meets twice monthly; priority to SVDP parishioners, other interested people may leave name/parish/contact for space availability. Bring own donated/spare yarn and usually hooks. Enquiries Ervinna via WhatsApp 8666 8222; no custom orders.
